protocolNotes.text: assistant.payloadSha256 is the sha-256 of the logical payload: the UTF-8 system instruction followed by the prompt, which is the fixture prompt plus its allowed requirement IDs in fixed order. It is not a hash of the wire request.

Each request narrows the requirementId enum to that fixture's allowed IDs; validation keeps the unmodified shared schema and checks returned IDs against the fixture. Adopted before any cohort started.

One record per trial. Every trial fills one slot of the frozen randomization.order and records slotId and slotAttempt. A replacement is a new trial in the same slot with the next slotAttempt; the highest attempt represents the slot. Earlier attempts are superseded: kept, counted and shown, but left out of medians and pairs. A slot with no record is missing.

A human action the protocol permits outside control mode (resolving an approval gate the run raised, answering a blocked worker, the owner's handover review) is counted in operations.permittedHumanActions with its minutes in humanMinutes.permittedAction. It does not set humanIntervened and does not remove the trial from comparisons; the report shows the count beside the mode. Control-mode use sets humanIntervened and keeps the trial out of comparisons.

The exporter fills each record's configuration from this manifest, including denied starts, and only from the manifest a track started under: its hash must equal the start's. Starter and candidate SHAs are full lowercase commit SHAs. Delivery times are on the server monotonic clock only.

repository.verifierSha256 and repository.lockfileSha256 freeze the verifier and lockfile before the cohorts run. Preflight recomputes both from the verifier's files and pnpm-lock.yaml with the verifier's own hashing, and refuses live dispatch when either differs from the frozen value, or when services/verifier/suites/feedback-board/HASHES.json is stale.

manifestSha256 is the sha-256 of this manifest's canonical JSON (sorted keys) with starts left out, so stamping a start does not change it. Records, starts and preflight all refer to the manifest by this hash.

record-start runs only on a passing preflight for its track. It writes the cohort-start file for the track (the preregistration record, kept in the repository) and stamps the same start time and manifest hash under starts. After either exists, freeze is refused, and preflight and export refuse a manifest whose hash differs from the start's (manifest_changed_after_start) or whose stamp and file disagree (start_record_mismatch).

The local export carries resultSha256, the hash of the unredacted record. The published copy drops it and carries publishedSha256, the hash of the redacted record with both hash fields left out, so a guessed host or account cannot be confirmed from the published file.

Human minutes are unavailable unless every category is recorded. A trial whose control-mode use or permitted human actions are not recorded is left out of pairs. Permitted human actions are shown per pair, and a difference within a pair is listed as a confounder.
